zh-TW.title: SuperTrack — 全網追蹤助手 | Pysdn SuperCool
zh-TW.description: SuperTrack：幫你追蹤網紅、品牌、熱門內容，自動整理成可用的創作素材。
zh-TW.hero_lead: 追蹤人、追蹤內容、整理成你的創作靈感
zh-TW.overview_p: SuperTrack 是 SuperForge 的外掛模組，專門幫你「追蹤網上發生的事 → 整理成有用的內容 → 變成你的提示詞素材」。
zh-TW.comp_1: 人物識別：同一個人在不同平台的帳號自動對上
zh-TW.comp_2: 智慧採集：像真人一樣幫你追蹤各平台的更新
zh-TW.comp_3: 自然瀏覽：模擬真人滾動、停留，不會被當機器人擋住
zh-TW.comp_4: 時間軸紀錄：所有內容按時間排好，方便回顧
zh-TW.comp_5: 預警通知：流量突然暴增？自動通知你
zh-TW.comp_6: 靈感庫串接：好內容自動存進你的提示詞素材庫
zh-TW.arch_pre:
[SuperTrack 開始追蹤] → [清理 + 識別人/品牌] → [按時間存好 + 預警]
                          ↓
[篩出高品質內容] → [AI 結構化整理] → [存進你的提示詞庫]
                          ↓
[你搜尋] → 「找某類風格的 Prompt」→ 自動附上來源帳號 + 互動數據參考
zh-TW.d1b: 發文頻率、互動率、標籤變化、合作品牌
zh-TW.d1c: 風格提示詞庫、趨勢預警
zh-TW.d2b: 產品曝光、用戶評價、促銷活動
zh-TW.d2c: 商業提示詞模板、競品分析
zh-TW.d3b: 新聞提及、輿情情感、關聯人物
zh-TW.d4b: 話題熱度、跨平台聲量、形象關鍵詞
zh-TW.d4c: 創意靈感召回、IP 聯動建議
zh-TW.stack_1: 儲存：PostgreSQL + 時間序列資料庫 + 向量搜尋
zh-TW.stack_2: 採集：模擬真人瀏覽器 + Python
zh-TW.stack_3: 部署：Windows 服務 + 本地儲存 + 雲端同步
zh-TW.doc_summary_p: 本頁說明 SuperTrack 的追蹤對象、採集與預警流程、與靈感庫／知識庫的銜接，以及合規與技術背景。僅處理公開可得之資料，請遵守各平台使用條款與 robots 規範。
zh-TW.h_platforms: 主流分享與社群平台（追蹤範圍示意）
zh-TW.platforms_lead: 設計上可涵蓋兩岸與國際常見的內容與社交網路。下列標籤與儀表板「訊號來源」示範矩陣一致，便於對照營運監測維度。
zh-TW.platforms_chips_cn: 小紅書|抖音|快手|Bilibili|微博|微信影片號|微信公眾號（公開可及）
zh-TW.platforms_note: 實際可用性依各平台公開資料政策、robots／服務條款與反自動化策略而定；若平台禁止自動化採集，系統會標示為不可用或降權。

en.title: SuperTrack — Web Tracking Assistant | Pysdn SuperCool
en.description: SuperTrack: track influencers, brands, and trending content—auto-organized into creative assets.
en.hero_lead: Track people, track content, turn it into creative inspiration
en.overview_p: SuperTrack is a SuperForge add-on that tracks what's happening online, organizes it, and turns it into prompt-ready素材 for your creative work.
en.comp_1: Person matching: same person across platforms, automatically linked
en.comp_2: Smart collection: tracks updates like a real person would
en.comp_3: Human-like browsing: scrolls, pauses, random timing—doesn't get blocked
en.comp_5: Alert engine: sudden traffic spike? You get notified
en.comp_6: Inspiration bridge: great content flows into your prompt library
en.arch_pre:
[SuperTrack starts tracking] → [clean + identify people/brands] → [store chronologically + alert]
                          ↓
[High-signal content] → [AI structures it] → [saved to your prompt library]
                          ↓
[You search] → "find prompts like this style" → source accounts + engagement data included
en.d1b: Post frequency, engagement, tag evolution, brand deals
en.d4b: Topic heat, cross-platform voice, image keywords
en.d4c: Creative inspiration recall, IP collaboration ideas
en.stack_1: Storage: PostgreSQL + time-series DB + vector search
en.stack_3: Deployment: Windows service + local storage + cloud sync
en.doc_summary_p: Explains SuperTrack targets, collection & alerts, handoff to your library, compliance, and stack notes—public data only; respect each platform’s terms.
en.platforms_lead: Designed to cover major creator and social networks across regions. Tags match the dashboard “signal sources” demo matrix for ops alignment.
en.platforms_note: Availability depends on each platform’s public-data rules, ToS, and anti-automation; blocked sources are marked disabled or down-ranked.

ko.comp_2: 스마트 수집: 사람처럼 각 플랫폼을 추적

ko.comp_5: 알림: 갑작스러운 트래픽 폭등 시 자동 통보
ko.comp_6: 영감 연결: 좋은 콘텐츠를 자동으로 프롬프트 라이브러리에 저장
ko.arch_pre:
[SuperTrack 추적 시작] → [정리 + 인물/브랜드 식별] → [시간순 저장 + 알림]
                          ↓
[고품질 콘텐츠] → [AI 구조화] → [프롬프트 라이브러리에 저장]
                          ↓
[사용자 검색] → "이 스타일의 프롬프트 찾기" → 출처 계정 + 인게이지먼트 데이터 포함

ko.d4b: 화제의 열기, 크로스플랫폼 영향력, 이미지 키워드
